info.name: OpenRAG API
info.description:
Every backend route of OpenRAG (from src/app/routes/internal.py, upstream v0.3.0), with the equivalent curl in each request's description.

BASE URL — one collection variable, `baseUrl`:
- Through the app (frontend proxy): baseUrl = http://34.102.202.103/api  (the frontend strips the /api prefix before hitting the backend)
- Direct to the backend (kubectl port-forward, in-cluster, local Docker): baseUrl = http://localhost:8000  (backend routes are UNPREFIXED — no /api)

Auth: the GKE deployment runs in no-auth mode (no Google OAuth client configured), so no headers are needed. On an authenticated deployment, sign in via the UI first — the API rides the session cookie.

Other variables: {{taskId}} (from an upload_ingest response), {{filterId}} (from a create-filter response).

variable.description: Host root. Via the app UI proxy include /api (default). Direct to the backend use the backend root with NO /api, e.g. http://localhost:8000 or http://openrag-backend:8000 in-cluster.
Ingestion task id returned by POST /router/upload_ingest.
Knowledge filter id returned by POST /knowledge-filter.

request.description:
Which chat/embedding providers are configured and healthy. Equivalent curl:

curl -X GET "{{baseUrl}}/provider/health"

Profile, roles and the permission list the UI gates on (e.g. chat:use, search:use). Equivalent curl:

curl -X GET "{{baseUrl}}/users/me"

The core retrieval call — this is what Khoj uses. filters can carry a filename whitelist, e.g. {"filename": ["doc-abc--file.pdf"]}. resultMode: chunks | knowledge_sources | website_pages.

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/search" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "What deductions are on the W-2?", "filters": {}, "limit": 10, "scoreThreshold": 0, "resultMode": "chunks"}'

Field is `prompt` — sending `message` returns 422. Optional: conversation_id (thread), filter_id (restrict to a knowledge filter), filters, stream.

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/chat" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Summarize the uploaded document.", "stream": false, "limit": 10, "scoreThreshold": 0}'

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/langflow" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Summarize the uploaded document.", "stream": false, "limit": 10, "scoreThreshold": 0}'

The file list is computed from chunk metadata in OpenSearch — per file: filename, chunks, indexed_time. This is the API behind Khoj's Super Admin matrix. Supports pagination (page, page_size), sort_by/sort_order, and filters incl. data_sources (repeatable filename whitelist).

Equivalent curl:

curl -X GET "{{baseUrl}}/files?page=1&page_size=100"

Deletes every chunk for that exact (scoped) filename. There is no DELETE /files/{id} route.

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/documents/delete-by-filename" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"filename": "doc-abc--file.pdf"}'

Multipart upload — the endpoint Khoj's web app uses. Returns a task id to poll. Form fields: file (repeatable), replace_duplicates, create_filter, preview, settings (JSON), tweaks (JSON).

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/router/upload_ingest" \
  -F "file=@/path/to/document.pdf" -F "replace_duplicates=true" -F "create_filter=false"

Poll after upload_ingest until the task completes. Equivalent curl:

curl -X GET "{{baseUrl}}/tasks/<task_id>"

Returns 201. OpenRAG's own convention is one filter per uploaded document (data_sources = [filename], name = filename minus extension). Khoj auto-creates one per upload.

Equivalent curl:

curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/knowledge-filter" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "2024 W2", "description": "", "queryData": {"query": "", "filters": {"data_sources": ["doc-abc--2024 W2.pdf"], "document_types": [], "owners": [], "connector_types": []}, "limit": 100, "scoreThreshold": 0}, "allowedUsers": [], "allowedGroups": []}'

Equivalent curl:

curl -X PUT "{{baseUrl}}/knowledge-filter/<filter_id>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "New name"}'

Agent model/provider, knowledge (embedding model, chunk size/overlap, OCR), onboarding state. Equivalent curl:

curl -X GET "{{baseUrl}}/settings"
